output.question: Is Discord publicly traded?
output.answer: No. As of mid-November 2026 Discord (Discord Inc.) is still a private company. It has no stock ticker and is not listed on any exchange. Bloomberg reported on January 7, 2026 that Discord had filed confidentially for a US IPO and was working with Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan, but the IPO has not priced. An IPO tracker last updated November 10, 2026 says Discord 'is still private' and that no public S-1 was on SEC EDGAR as of October 21, 2026. Shares trade only privately on secondary markets, which have reportedly valued the company at about $8.5B.

key_facts.fact: Bloomberg reported that Discord filed confidentially for an IPO, with Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan working on the listing. People familiar with the plans said the company could decide not to go ahead.
Discord is still private and the IPO has not priced. As of October 21, 2026 there was no public S-1 on SEC EDGAR, only Form D filings.
A KuCoin news flash said a 277-page S-1 had been filed, but it did not say Discord had listed. The claim conflicts with other reporting.

passages.quote: Discord Inc. filed confidentially for an initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter.
no public S-1 is on SEC EDGAR

caveats: Discord has not confirmed the confidential IPO filing. Bloomberg's report relies on unnamed sources, and the company could still decide not to list.
Reports on a public S-1 conflict: a May 2026 KuCoin news flash says one was filed, while ValueAddVC says EDGAR showed none as of Oct 21, 2026. Neither claim was checked directly against SEC EDGAR.
The ValueAddVC status claims are dated October 21, 2026, so something could have changed in the last few weeks. I found no reports of a Discord listing in November 2026.
The ~$8.5B secondary-market valuation comes from search-result snippets and aggregator sites that I did not open. Treat it as approximate.
Any 'Discord ticker' you see online is unofficial.
